title: Field-Probe: Micro-Market Demand Signals for Low-Latency Model Bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: run a focused, field-style probe across three micro-markets (NA-west, EU-central, APAC-sg) to gather demand signals for pre-bundled low-latency model configurations and measure the real-world economics of fallback paths.

Why now: customers increasingly ask for latency guarantees and predictable cost when model variants or regions fall back. Existing landscape work catalogs model capabilities but lacks ground-truth demand/sensitivity signals that link buyer willingness-to-pay to concrete fallback SLOs and quantization trade-offs. This probe is intended to bridge that gap and produce actionable thresholds for product packaging and Dedicated capacity triggers.

Scope:
- Create synthetic and sampled customer workloads for three archetypes: conversational chat (short-turn), streaming summarization (medium context), embeddings-heavy vector indexing (short queries high QPS).
- Deploy lightweight test harness in three regions using hosted and Dedicated routing variants; include quantized model variants (fp16, 4-bit quant) and a smaller fallback model family.
- Measure tail latency (p50, p95, p99), token cost-per-response, and user-perceived degradation via quality checks on a curated prompt set.
- Conduct 8 buyer interviews across SMB and midmarket customers in the target regions to capture WTP (willingness to pay) for latency SLOs and tolerance for quality loss during fallback.
- Produce a scoring rubric that maps region+workload -> recommended bundle (hosted tier, dedicated reserve, fallback thresholds, suggested quant profile).

Success metrics (deliverables):
- A reproducible benchmark workbook with region-specific p50/p95/p99 and cost per 1k responses for each model variant.
- Scoring rubric and decision matrix that yields a recommended bundle for at least 6 customer archetype scenarios.
- 8 validated buyer interview summaries tagged by latency sensitivity and procurement stage.
- Three product proposals: (A) latency-prioritized hosted bundle, (B) cost-prioritized dedicated bundle, (C) hybrid fallback SLA with automatic quant-fallback.

Out of scope: full enterprise procurement pilots, full Private on‑prem installs, long-term A/B rollout experiments beyond initial canary suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark workbook uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket
Region-run p50/p95/p99 and cost metrics for all three workload archetypes
Buyer interview transcripts and 8 short summaries in Confluence
Scoring rubric with numerical thresholds that produces deterministic bundle recommendations
PM sign-off on three product proposals with next-step RFCs for engineering and growth
